integrity: The analytic proof establishes the infinite-dimensional and limiting results; the finite standard-library checker is supplementary. No independent mathematical audit has been carried out.
limitations: The theorem does not cover more than two distinct nonzero spectral values or arbitrary nonnormal operators.
The equal-modulus limiting formula and the projectively orthogonal special case already occur in earlier published mathematical results and are not claimed as independently new.
Publication priority relative to any unindexed older trigonometric-envelope calculation is not independently confirmed.
scientific_scope: Normal operators on complex Hilbert spaces of the form aP+bQ for two nonzero orthogonal projections, unequal positive eigenvalue moduli, and possibly a zero spectral subspace.
title: Two-point normal \(L^2\)-Cartesian phase law and cubic crossover
